title: What Is the False Cause Fallacy? — Critical Thinking Basics
skills: define and recognize the false cause fallacy
distinguish correlation, sequence, and coincidence from demonstrated causation
evaluate causal arguments for sufficient evidence and logical support
alignment_note: Explains the false cause fallacy and how unsupported assumptions about cause and effect can weaken an argument. Supports logical-fallacy recognition, causal reasoning, evidence evaluation, argument analysis, and critical thinking across high school English courses.
